market_summary: During the late New York session, all six tracked assets are stuck in low-volatility, mid-channel consolidation regimes following earlier directional moves. Volatility is universally contracting across FX, metals, indices, and crypto, with RVOL remaining well below the 2.0 expansion threshold (all printing grey volume bars). US100 and XAUUSD are both constrained by GEX structures (US100 below Gamma Flip in a negative amplifying regime between Put Wall #1 and EMA50; XAUUSD dampened below Call Wall #2), while EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAGUSD, and BTCUSD hover near fair value or drift sideways above session lows without liquidity sweeps. Disciplined execution dictates a flat HOLD across the entire batch.
